memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: follow‑up of hypothyroidism and vitamin D deficiency.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports feeling fatigued, mild weight gain, no palpitations or heat intolerance.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 62 kg, height 1.55 m giving BMI 25.8 (obese). Advised on reduced calorie intake and daily walking.
IMPRESSION: Ongoing levothyroxine 50 mcg OD; TSH and free T4 pending. Vitamin D deficiency confirmed, replacement started.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting TSH, free T4, serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate. Continue levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, start cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD. Return if new palpitations, heat intolerance, excessive thirst, or fever >39°C. Influenza vaccine offered; patient declined today.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: review after labs, persistent fatigue.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Fatigue unchanged, no weight change, denies palpitations.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/86 mmHg, weight 62.5 kg, BMI 26.0 (obese). Advised on diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Hypothyroidism with TSH still above target; need dose increase. Vitamin D remains low.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat TSH and free T4 in 6 weeks. Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD. Continue vitamin D regimen. Return if palpitations, tremor, weight loss, or fever >39°C. Influenza vaccine not due.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: low vitamin D level, review of thyroid.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She feels better, less fatigue, no new symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 62 kg, BMI 25.8 (obese). Advised on diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Hypothyroidism stable on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Vitamin D deficiency persists.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate in 3 months. Restart cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD. Return if nausea, vomiting, polyuria, or fever >39°C. Influenza vaccine offered; patient accepted and vaccine given today (15‑Sep‑2025).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: annual metabolic review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She feels well, no thyroid symptoms, denies bone pain.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 61.8 kg, BMI 25.6 (obese). Advised on diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Vitamin D now sufficient after replacement. Lipid profile and fasting glucose ordered as annual screen.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar. Continue current meds. Return if chest pain, dyspnea, unexplained weight loss, or fever >39°C. Influenza vaccine not due (given Sep 2025).

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting total cholesterol 210 mg/dL (ref <200). LDL 130 mg/dL (ref <100). HDL 48 mg/dL (ref >40). Triglycerides 160 mg/dL (ref <150). Fasting blood sugar 98 mg/dL (ref 70‑100).

Reason: routine follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports good energy, no adverse symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 61.5 kg, BMI 25.4 (obese). Advised on diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Stable euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Vitamin D adequate. Atorvastatin tolerated.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat TSH and free T4 in 6 months; lipid panel in 1 year. Continue meds. Return if palpitations, muscle pain, dark urine, or fever >39°C. Influenza vaccine not due.
